blocks.text: JAKARTA, Indonesia — The death toll from flooding in an illegal gold mine on Indonesia’s Java island, following heavy rain, rose to 13, a rescue official said Thursday, with more than a dozen others still missing. Mining accidents are common across the mineral-rich Southeast Asian archipelago, especially on unlicensed sites where safety protocols are lax
